title: Post-Collision Repair Guidance
queue: Brand Engagement Center + Toyota Certified Collision Center locator
vehicle: 2022 Camry, airbags did not deploy, bumper and windshield damage
location: At home the day after a crash; vehicle drivable
coverage: Insurance claim open; Genuine parts and ADAS calibration at issue

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Toyota Brand Engagement, how can I help?

segments.speaker: Patient
segments.text: I was in a crash yesterday. The insurance shop wants aftermarket parts. Where should I take the car?

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: You can choose a Toyota Certified Collision Center. That matters for airbags and Safety Sense calibration after bumper or windshield work.

segments.speaker: Patient
segments.text: The insurer said I have to use their shop.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: You generally choose the repair facility. I can locate a Toyota Certified Collision Center and note Genuine parts plus ADAS recalibration on the file.

segments.speaker: Patient
segments.text: Yes, please find a certified center near me. I do not want the radar to be wrong.
